title: 1986 LEAF ALL-STAR GAME POP-UP MLB CARD MIKE SCHMIDT PHILADELPHIA PHILLIES
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1986 Leaf All-Star Game Pop-Up MLB trading card featuring Mike Schmidt of the Philadelphia Phillies. It is an original card from the 1986 Leaf Canadian set, part of the base set with a pop-up feature. The card is unsigned and showcases Schmidt as an MLB player in the Major League.
